answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 174207 Country: India Title: How to divide property of father (who is no more) among four sons, three married daughters and a wife? Question: How to divide property of father (who is no more) among four sons, three married daughters and a wife? Answer ID: 174207 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 184/145/D=3/1441) If at the time of your father’s death none among his parents was alive then all the property of your father shall be divided into 88 shares, after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of total, the wife shall get 11 shares, each son shall get 14-14 shares and each daughter shall get 7-7 shares. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Wife: 1 x 11 = 11 Sons: 4 x 14 = 56 Daughter: 3 x 07 = 21 Total 88 shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
